bio: Centrally located, just a stone's throw from the train station, this lovely inn has also proved to be a hit with locals. A simple and fuss-free setting in which to enjoy the decidedly fresh and tasty food prepared in the open kitchen. In addition to more ambitious fare, classics such as schnitzel or roast beef also go down well with diners. Simpler and shorter lunchtime menu. Charming inner courtyard....
